scenario.title: 講一段有趣的遭遇
scenario.context: 說故事是英文口說的綜合考驗：要用過去式推進情節、過去進行式鋪背景、過去完成式交代更早的事，還要用 as soon as、by the time、just as 這些時間連接詞把事件串起來。講得好，聽的人才會跟著你的節奏走。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: You won't believe what happened to me last weekend.
lines.zh: 你絕對不會相信我上週末發生什麼事。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: So I was going to my cousin's wedding. I'd never been to that hotel before, so I was running a bit late.
lines.zh: 我那時要去參加表姊的婚禮。我從沒去過那間飯店，所以有點遲到。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: As soon as I walked in, someone handed me a glass of champagne and pointed me to a table.
lines.zh: 我一走進去，就有人遞給我一杯香檳，指引我到一張桌子。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: I was chatting with the people at my table when I realized I didn't recognize anyone.
lines.zh: 我正在跟同桌的人聊天時，突然發現我一個人都不認識。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: Wrong wedding. By the time I found my cousin's hall, they had already cut the cake.
lines.zh: 走錯婚禮。等我找到我表姊的宴會廳時，他們已經切完蛋糕了。

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.en: So how did you get the job at the new agency?
lines.zh: 所以你是怎麼拿到新公司那份工作的？

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: Long story short, a former client recommended me.
lines.zh: 長話短說，一位以前的客戶推薦了我。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: I hadn't talked to her in two years. Then out of the blue, she messaged me.
lines.zh: 我已經兩年沒跟她聯絡了，然後她突然傳訊息給我。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: Just as I was about to go to bed, the agency called. The next thing I knew, I had an interview the next morning.
lines.zh: 就在我正要上床睡覺時，那家公司打來了。接著我就知道隔天早上有面試。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: It all happened within 24 hours. I still can't believe it.
lines.zh: 整件事 24 小時內就發生了，我到現在還不敢相信。

patterns.zh: 你絕對不會相信發生了什麼事。

patterns.en: By the time I ___, ___ had already ___.
patterns.zh: 等我 ___ 的時候，___ 已經 ___ 了。

patterns.en: Just as I was about to ___, ___.

patterns.zh: 猜猜接下來發生什麼事？

chinglish.wrong: When I arrive the hotel, I see many people.
chinglish.right: When I arrived at the hotel, I saw lots of people.
chinglish.why: 說故事要全程用過去時態，arrive 還要加 at。中文說故事常用現在式，台灣人翻成英文時會忘記切換。

chinglish.wrong: I talked with them and then I found I don't know anyone.
chinglish.right: I was chatting with them when I realized I didn't know anyone.
chinglish.why: 背景用過去進行式、突發事件用過去式（複習第 28 單元），整個故事都要統一在過去。

chinglish.wrong: When I found the right room, they cut the cake already.
chinglish.right: By the time I found the right room, they had already cut the cake.
chinglish.why: 更早發生的事用過去完成式（複習第 32 單元）。

chinglish.right: Then out of the blue, she called me.
chinglish.why: 英文說故事用多種轉折詞增加變化，不重複 suddenly。

grammar.title: 敘事時態＋by the time / as soon as
grammar.oneLiner: 說故事的四個時態：過去式推情節、過去進行式鋪背景、過去完成式交代更早的事、would / was going to 講「當時的未來」；再用時間連接詞串起來。
whenToUse: 過去式：主要事件。I walked in. Someone handed me a drink.
過去進行式：背景或被打斷的動作。I was chatting when I realized…
過去完成式：比主線更早的事。I'd never been there before.
as soon as：一…就…。As soon as I walked in, …
by the time：等到…的時候（前面的事已經完成）。By the time I arrived, they had left.
just as：就在…的那一刻。Just as I was leaving, the phone rang.
the moment / once：一旦。The moment I saw her, I knew.
grammar.whyWeGetItWrong: 中文說故事常用現在式（「然後我走進去，看到一群人」），讓聽眾有臨場感。英文口語也有這種用法，但對學習者來說，混用現在式和過去式會讓時間線大亂。更重要的是，英文說故事時靠時態區分背景、主線和倒敘，這是中文靠語境處理的東西。整合前面學過的時態，是 B2 口說的關鍵。

examples.correct: As soon as I got home, I jumped in the shower.
examples.incorrect: As soon as I will get home, I jumped in the shower.
examples.note: 過去的故事全用過去式。

examples.correct: By the time we arrived, the show had already started.
examples.note: by the time + 過去完成式。

examples.correct: Just as I was locking the door, I heard a noise.
I was walking home when I saw a cat stuck in a tree.
I had never met her before, but she knew my name.
examples.note: 過去完成式交代更早的狀態。

quiz.question: ___ I opened the door, the cat ran out.
By the time I got to the station, the train ___.
quiz.explanation: by the time + 過去完成式。

quiz.question: Just as I ___ (leave), my boss called me into her office.
I ___ my phone when I heard someone scream.
quiz.explanation: 被打斷的背景用過去進行式。

quiz.question: I ___ never been to a wedding that big before.
quiz.explanation: 過去完成式交代更早的經驗。

examples.en: Long story short, we missed the flight.
examples.zh: 長話短說，我們錯過班機了。

examples.en: Long story short, I got the job!
examples.zh: 總之，我拿到那份工作了！

slang.usage: 像晴天霹靂一樣突然發生。

examples.en: My old friend called me out of the blue.
examples.zh: 我的老朋友突然打給我。

examples.en: The offer came out of the blue.
examples.zh: 那個 offer 來得毫無預警。

slang.usage: You won't believe what happened / who I saw. 說故事的吸睛開場。

examples.en: You won't believe who I ran into at the airport.
examples.zh: 你絕對不會相信我在機場遇到誰。

examples.en: You won't believe how much they charged us.
examples.zh: 你不會相信他們收了我們多少錢。

slang.meaning: 接下來我只知道、轉眼間
slang.usage: 表示事情發生得很快，來不及反應。

examples.en: I sat down on the couch, and the next thing I knew, it was morning.
examples.zh: 我在沙發上坐下，轉眼間就天亮了。

examples.en: The next thing I knew, I was on stage singing karaoke.
examples.zh: 接下來我只知道，我已經在台上唱卡拉 OK 了。

review.question: My cousin is ___ telling that same story!
review.explanation: 複習第 78 單元：always + 進行式表抱怨。

review.question: Make ___ at home!
review.explanation: 複習第 77 單元：make yourself at home。

review.question: A: Didn't you go to the wedding? B: (你有去) ___
options: Yes, I did. The wrong one!
review.explanation: 複習第 75 單元：有去就說 Yes。

review.question: I'll never forget ___ into the wrong wedding.
review.explanation: 複習第 71 單元：forget + V-ing = 忘記做過。

review.question: ___ being late, I still had a great time.
___ into the hall, I noticed everyone staring at me.
review.explanation: 複習第 47 單元：分詞構句。

review.question: Which is correct?
review.explanation: 複習第 15 單元：be 動詞後放頻率副詞。

review.question: By the time I arrived, the party ___.
review.explanation: by the time + 過去完成式。
